proposals.rationale: curated: the LOINC component "Hemoglobin A1c" names a protein modification (glycated hemoglobin), so the analyte is a D2 MolecularEntity, not a D1 substance

notes: Fixture intent (fixture ids). Assessments s01/s02 are not in intent v1. Quest MEASURES_METRIC (d02) is a curator proposal (status PROPOSED) because the Quest LOINC section is gated. PERFORMED_BY_LAB (d05) is a curator inference asserted by agent-curation with basisKind CURATOR_CLASSIFICATION (R-26/R-25; the sample report lab block is a 2018 placeholder); v1 AssertionCore has no derivationRule field, so the inference rule is in the rationale. payloadHash of AssayVersion and ReferenceIntervalVersion is executor-computed and therefore omitted. INTERFERES_WITH on a Device widens the 05 predicateOnly subject (recorded there).
